text:
alex: FYI - Priority customer (acme-eu) reporting repeated Xid 61 on node gpu-az4-023. We auto-drained but they still see sporadic OOMs.

nina: logs?

alex: attached snippet: ```[ 122.314s] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 61, PID=3421 irq 48 ```

ben: can you post the host serial and GPU serials? need to match against depot.

alex: host serial HST-EU-2345, GPU serials: SN-GPU-9312 (slot A), SN-GPU-9312 (slot B) — weird duplicate, looks like labeling on kitting is wrong.

sara: if it's duplicate on inventory, we should halt any depot swap. possible cross-serial paste. I'll ping warehouse.

ops-bot: [automated] node gpu-az4-023 drained; 4 containers relocated; scheduled maintenance window 22:00 UTC.

nina: vendor RMA queue priority? customer is enterprise tier.

tilly-vendor: from vendor side — ticket RMA-789402 opened. ETA for depot swap manifest 48-72h once we confirm correct serials.

ben: 48-72h is long. can we hot-swap at the LHR edge? do we have spare in LHR hotbin? inventory shows HOTBIN-LHR-02 with one T4 spare.

alex: LHR spare is already reserved for another job, but we can reassign if exec approves.

sara: cc @maria-finance for cost approval for hotbin reallocation. option B is air-ship new GPU to eu-central expedited (~$1200).

maria-finance: approve expedited swap for customer SLA breach. please provide final cost ticket.

ben: ok I'll create a short runbook for on-site tech. Alex — can you confirm the physical slot map and kvm access?

alex: confirmed. slot map: A=SN-GPU-9312, B=SN-GPU-4401 (inventory corrected), cable pcie-1 goes to riser 3. KVM creds in lastpass 'data-center/gpu-az4-023'.

nina: before swap, run nvml diag: ```nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,ECC```, capture output and send to vendor.

alex: running now, pasting output: ```ECC errors: 0 correctable, 243 uncorrectable``` — that's consistent with failing behavior.

ben: good. next steps: (1) reserve LHR hotbin or approve airship, (2) vendor to generate depot manifest with corrected serials, (3) schedule field tech for hot-swap window 22:00 UTC. I'll file infra ticket INFRA-5427 with details.

tilly-vendor: noted; we'll expedite manifest once INFRA-5427 is attached with serial photos and nvml output.

sara: warehouse - do not cross-ship SN-GPU-9312 until photos confirmed. tagging hold.

alex: uploading photos to INFRA-5427 now.

ben: thanks — looping in on-call @tej in case swap runs into unexpected node drain cascade.

tej: I can be on-call tonight. if anything blocks, ping my mobile.

nina: resolving into tasks — I'll convert this thread into checklist and update INFRA-5427. keep replies brief here.

alex: thanks team. :thumbsup:
